notes.title: Independent game "N+1: New life for unemployed youth!" 》Officially launched！！
notes.content:
【Game Introduction】:
You will play the role of an unemployed young man, working hard to live, make money, eat, drink and have fun in this magical world, while looking for the trivial truth.
This may be the most confusing game you've ever played. But if you can persist for 30 days, or kill all NPCs mercilessly, you will get a cross-dimensional gaming experience.


【Game Features】:
Simulate a new life after unemployment, work hard to survive and improve yourself, and live a good life every day. You can gain a lot of wealth and reach the top of your life, but you may also live a miserable life because you are not cautious enough.

Shopping: Food and books named after popular internet memes, the main focus is a whole activity.


Doing odd jobs: Encounter 100 random events, and different choices lead to different endings.


Reciting poems and making pairs: an innovative mini-game based on the theme of "Four Seasons + Ancient Poems".


Big talk dice: a must-have unique way to play in KTV for late-night snacking and drinking at food stalls in Guangdong, China.


Stock market: buy low, sell high, stock predictions.


Card Game: An innovative mini-game that combines the "Tian Ji Horse Racing" and "SNAP (Points Competition)" mechanisms.


Auction treasures: Compete with NPC auction collectibles, the one with the highest price will win.


Antique identification: an innovative mini-game based on "Chinese mythology".


Revolving Piano: A stream-of-consciousness gameplay that combines "piano" and "plot narrative".


Massage: appetite, sensuality, pleasure. 13 beautiful chefs use professional techniques to guide you away from the trap of consumerism.


Cyberspace: Explore various issues in the world in the form of questions and answers, which is the key entrance to the plot narrative.


Five Elements Replacement: A numerical exchange game based on the theme of "Five Elements and Bagua".


In addition, you can also have simple interactions with NPCs, such as eating, drinking, borrowing money, and sleeping. Plus, you'll encounter mysterious signals that connect videos of real people in the real world.

May the glory of mankind last forever!

Thank you for your attention and support. If you have any suggestions, please join the game player group for discussion!

Rich woman address book group 2: 853636333

notes.title: The independent game "N+1", which is full of magical reality and personal avant！
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am Uncle Kun.

The independent game "N+1: New Life for Unemployed Youth" produced after 1 year of practice will be launched soon!

This is a game with a strong sense of magical reality and avant-gardism.

You will find it strange when you experience it for the first time, and you will still find it strange when you experience it again.

Today, I will take you to experience its strangeness.

On the first day of the game, you will receive a text message.

The content probably means: Ah, you are unemployed! !

Then you receive 3,000 yuan in unemployment benefits and live on.

Well, if you follow the normal simulation business gameplay.

You will pursue attributes and cash during the long game.

Gain satisfaction through numerical growth.

but! This work does not.

Death is allowed.

Lying down and lying down is also allowed.

The NPCs in the game will also accompany you to eat, drink and have fun.

even......

As a result, you will be lost and without a sense of purpose.

"Who am I? Where am I? What do I want to do?"

If you watch the live video of the game.

Well, that’s right, there is this thing in the game.

You will be informed of the purpose of "pursuing the truth."

"Then what's the truth?"

Yes, we humans are always troubled by endless problems.

Create problems, then solve them, then create problems again.

It's okay, let's take our time.

As a game, forgetting about problems may be one of its functions.

OK, it seems a bit far off, right?

Next, I’ll talk about what’s fun about this game.

In Wensen Study Room, you can: buy things, do odd jobs, eat and drink, and hold ancient poetry conferences

Shopping: Incorporated into a lot of hot internet memes (well, some of them are already outdated)

Doing odd jobs: In the process of working, you will also encounter many outrageous random events.

Eating and drinking: Will restore fullness based on your favorability with Uncle Vincent.

Ancient Poetry Conference: This gameplay is more literary and artistic.

After entering the game, a random season will serve as the tone.

For example, randomly select "Spring (slip of the tongue)"

Select the score that represents the characteristics of spring (slip of the tongue) among the dropped poems.

If you select another season, points will be deducted and you will eventually receive cash based on your score.

In Uncle Kun Game, you can: stock market, dice, drinking, destiny cards

Stock market: Buy low and sell high. The characteristic is that you can obtain intelligence predictions for tomorrow.

Big Talk Dice: A must-have game in Guangdong food stalls. The key is to guess the number and quantity of the opponent's dice.

Drinking: Well, drinking, drinking will make you energetic.

Destiny Card: The gameplay mechanism combines Tian Ji horse racing and SNAP point competition.

In Jiayi Music, you can: rare goods, auction, borrow money, revolving piano

Strange goods: identify artifacts and combine them with Chinese mythological themes to complete the task.

Auction: Compete with NPC for auction, and collectibles will be related to the income of all gameplays.

Borrowing money: As the name suggests, it means prostitution for free. As for how much you can borrow, it depends on whether you are familiar with it...

Revolving Piano: Personally, I think this is a more philosophical way of playing.

Every time you play the piano, your satiety will be reduced by 1 point, and other attributes will be randomly increased.

Scenes and characters are randomly combined from the plot, and some narratives will also be reorganized.

Here, the main focus is a sense of body.

At Yanjie Hair Salon, you can: massage, cyberspace, sleep, and replace the five elements.

Massage: Serious! serious! serious! It’s really not the LSP that everyone imagined

Cyberspace: Sets up a lot of questions and the player has six options.

They are: agreement, opposition, silence, surprise, anger, and regret.

Different options will trigger different answers and have a chance of triggering the plot.

I incorporated plot narrative here mainly to disrupt the order of the narrative.

The narrative effects presented in different orders may be surprising.

Sleep: Restoring mobility is also a serious mechanism.

Five Elements Replacement: This is a partial value gameplay, mainly to balance the negative feedback caused by randomness.

The above is all the contents of the trial version!

Of course, this game also hides a lot of things.

If you are interested, you are welcome to download and try it on Steam.

Also, please add to your wishlist! Wishlist! Wishlist!

This game is expected to be launched on a Friday in January 2024.

I’d like to bow and thank you in advance. It’s up to everyone whether you have money to celebrate the New Year!

886

notes.content:
Dear Players,
The Steam Next Fest has come to a successful end! We would like to thank each and every one of you who participated in the event and supported us.

Once again, we would like to thank all players for their support and participation. We look forward to sharing the joy of gaming with you as we continue our journey.

notes.title: The game scene of "N+1: New Life for Unemployed Youth"
notes.content:
Because of being laid off by the company, I like to mention N+1 (compensation), so I resolutely developed a game called "N+1" by myself.
Now that the development time has reached more than half a year, it's time to meet everyone. Friends who are interested can try it out and click on the wish list. Thank you very much! !

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353320/N1/]Wish List Portal[/url][/b]

[h2]⬇️⬇️⬇️Game Introduction⬇️⬇️⬇️[/h2]
This is a hyper-realistic simulation game, in fact, it is a meta-game with the fur of "simulation" [Meta game (also known as: Metagaming), or game about games, refers to any game that goes beyond the rules of the game and uses external Factors that affect the game, or the way games are played beyond the constraints or circumstances set by the game. 】

Therefore, the player will play the role of an unemployed young man with a huge sum of 3,000 yuan to survive in this city and earn more money. This is the first goal. Until the player completes the small goal and earns 100 million, then there is a chance to get in touch with the truth (what is the truth? Of course, it cannot be spoiled here)

Player Q group: 853636333

Simulation gameplay is the first part of the game. In simulation gameplay, players only need to do two things: survive and earn money.

[h2]The specific gameplay functions are:[/h2]

[h2]1. Random event:[/h2]
Currently there are 100 random events, 70 small events, and 30 large events. The main content of the copywriting is hot stalks in recent years, combining life, science, philosophy and other aspects of the unconstrained style, and making fun of it in a witty and funny way.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/suiji.gif?t=1687240321[/img]

[h2]2. Investment x operation x stock market:[/h2]
Players can inject/withdraw capital to NPC stores. When the capital injection ratio exceeds 50%, they can change the business strategy of the store. The business strategy will greatly affect the profit, turnover and valuation of the store. When the store reaches a certain scale, it can be listed and linked to the stock market.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/touzi.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/touzi.gif[/img]
[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/gushi.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/gushi.gif[/img]
[/img]

[h2]3. Big talk dice:[/h2]
This is a game of playing with NPCs, with strategies and randomness. You need to guess the number of dice for each point of both parties. Show the dice numbers to see who guesses right. It may be a bit abstract to express in words, and you may know it after just playing.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/dahuashai.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/dahuashai.gif[/img]
[/img]

[h2]4. Rare goods:[/h2]
There is a certain success rate in the way of appraising antiques, and the success of the appraisal will increase the level and value of antiques. According to the level of antiques, players receive attribute rewards every day. This mechanism is mainly used as a narrative supplement and numerical compensation, using fixed output to reduce the impact of randomness.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/guwan.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/guwan.gif[/img]
[/img]

[h2]5. Auction:[/h2]
The main source of collectibles, the base price will be randomly refreshed according to the rarity, and then the NPC will ask you for the price, and the highest price will win. Collectibles will affect the income of all gameplays, which is a snowball setting.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/paimai.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/paimai.gif[/img]
[/img]

[h2]6. Massage:[/h2]
Players can't directly use cash to massage, but need to "recharge money", recharge 100 to get 200, recharge 1000 to get 5000, this is to tease the setting of VIP card in life, you can also accumulate the total consumption to increase your membership grade. Does this setting look familiar? However, this is just a stand-alone game, you don't need to pay for it, it's just a joke.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/anmo.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/anmo.gif[/img]
[/img]

[h2]7. Marriage:[/h2]
During the game, the NPC will be unlocked, and the interaction with the NPC is mainly chatting and working. More functions such as dating, marriage, and childbirth will be arranged in the future.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/liaotian.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/liaotian.gif[/img]
[/img]

[h2]8. Plot narrative:[/h2]
This part is more like an AVG. Players can choose time, place, and gifts to date NPCs. Different choices will lead to different plot contents. Players can also choose directions in the plot to achieve different small endings.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2353320/extras/juqing.gif?t=1687240321[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/juqing.gif[/img]
[/img]

[b]Of course, it's just a simulation game, I don't think it's good enough. I still want some personal expression in it, so I use the meta element as the core entry point. However, it is not appropriate to reveal too much about the content of the current version. I hope that the game will have multiple reversal experiences. [/b]

notes.title: "N+1" Debuts at Steam Next Fest Today!
notes.content:
A new adventure, a new challenge! When you're laid off by the company and receive a severance package, how will you start your new life? Let's experience "N+1", a unique surrealist life simulation game together. We have now participated in Steam Next Fest, where all players are welcome to come and play for free!

The Steam Next Fest started at 10:00 on June 19, 2023, Pacific Time, and will continue until 10:00 on June 26. During this period, you can download and play "N+1" for free on its Steam store page.
Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353320/N1/
